section_or_rule_title: Act not to apply to certain premises (The ₹3,500 Threshold)
legal_status_notes: CRITICAL RAG RULE FOR DELHI: Under Section 3(c) (inserted w.e.f. 1 December 1988), if the monthly rent exceeds ₹3,500, the Delhi Rent Control Act DOES NOT APPLY. Because modern rentals in Delhi almost universally exceed ₹3,500/month, tenants and landlords in Delhi fall under the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (ss. 105-117) and normal civil suits, NOT the Rent Controller.

chapter_or_part: Chapter III: Control of Eviction of Tenants
legal_status_notes: Statutory protection against eviction for rent <= ₹3,500/month. Notice of demand gives 2 months to pay arrears.
